about: Independent out-of-sample audit of the CODE-GRAPH D3 JVM resolver's output on nextcloud/android 6722740 (clone at E:/yardstick/nextcloud-android), 2026-09-28. The sample (60 edges, 25 unresolved call sites, 30 dead-code claims) was drawn with seed 20260928, stratified by tier. The auditor did not read the resolver source (singularity/) or the yardstick labels (tests/fixtures/code_graph_edges_jvm.json); every verdict was judged from the Java/Kotlin language rules and the clone's source only (declared/inferred static types, imports, smart casts, flavor source sets from app/build.gradle.kts, and a whole-clone text search for dead-code claims including .kt/.java/.kts/.xml/.properties). Qname convention as given by the caller: constructor calls target the class qname, overloads share a qname, a call through a static interface/base type targets the nearest declaration walking up from that type.

fixed: e48 (the one wrong edge): `variant` now means one definition per build-flavor source set; several left in ONE source set are an ambiguity and draw nothing, unless the implicit receiver picks one extension -- matched against the enclosing types AND the supertypes written outside the graph (AppCompatActivity). Test: test_same_named_extensions_are_told_apart_by_the_implicit_receiver, test_several_definitions_in_one_source_set_are_not_variants.
d01 (used, called dead): Kotlin identifiers carry their Java bean spellings, and `isFoo = true` names setFoo. Test: test_kotlin_chained_calls_sit_on_their_own_line_and_is_properties_name_setters.

d19 (used, called dead): deadcode reads src/<set>/resources/**/*.properties and META-INF/services for class names a library loads by reflection. Test: test_what_android_starts_is_alive_and_what_nothing_names_is_dead.
u23 (missed): a Java pattern variable (`o instanceof T name`) is a typed local. Test: test_java_pattern_variables_are_typed_and_chained_calls_sit_on_their_own_line.
e33/e35 (reported at the chain's first line): a call is now recorded at the line of its name.
not_fixed: u06 (type from a `when` of enum entries), u20 (Kotlin smart cast), u24 (a lambda parameter typed by a generic): type flow the resolver does not track; a function-wide hint for a smart cast would be wrong outside its `if`.
